title: Freeform agent note idea
transcript: Voice note, random product idea. Throughline should let me dump anything, not just a morning ritual. If I say remind me to ask Dan about the API limit, my agent should see that as a note and a task later. Tag this maybe MCP and onboarding. No urgent deadline.

expected.title: Throughline notes should accept anything
expected.summary: The note argues that Throughline should support arbitrary voice notes for agents, not only morning rituals, and includes a reminder to ask Dan about an API limit.

todos.text: Ask Dan about the API limit

intentions: Let users dump anything into Throughline, not just morning rituals
